com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.config

Class ClientRoutesConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.config.ClientRoutesConfig

  • @Immutable
public final class ClientRoutesConfig
extends Object
    Configuration for client routes, used in cloud private-endpoint deployments.

    Client routes enable the driver to discover and connect to nodes through a load balancer (such as AWS PrivateLink, Azure Private Link, or GCP Private Service Connect) by reading endpoint mappings from the system.client_routes table. Each endpoint is identified by a connection ID and maps to specific node addresses.

    This configuration is mutually exclusive with a user-provided AddressTranslator. If client routes are configured, the driver will use its internal client routes handler for address translation.

    Example usage: 

    
 ClientRoutesConfig config = ClientRoutesConfig.builder()
     .addEndpoint(new ClientRouteProxy(
         "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012",
         "my-cluster-endpoint.example.com"))
     .build();

 CqlSession session = CqlSession.builder()
     .withClientRoutesConfig(config)
     .build();
    See Also:
    SessionBuilder.withClientRoutesConfig(ClientRoutesConfig), ClientRouteProxy

    • Field Detail

      • DEFAULT_NATIVE_TRANSPORT_PORT

        public static final int DEFAULT_NATIVE_TRANSPORT_PORT
        Default native transport port used by Scylla/Cassandra nodes. This is used as the fallback port for broadcastRpcAddress when the system tables do not include port information (e.g. older Scylla versions without system.peers_v2). The broadcastRpcAddress is how the driver matches TOPOLOGY_CHANGE events (node added/removed) to nodes in its metadata — it is NOT used for opening connections. Connections go through ClientRoutesEndPoint which resolves via the NLB proxy addresses in the routes cache.
        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • getNativeTransportPort

        public int getNativeTransportPort()
        Returns the native transport port of the cluster nodes. This port is used as the fallback for building broadcastRpcAddress when system tables lack port columns. The broadcastRpcAddress is used only to match TOPOLOGY_CHANGE events to metadata nodes — it is NOT used to open connections (those go through the NLB proxy endpoints from the routes cache).
        Returns:
        the native transport port (defaults to 9042).

      • isShardAwarenessEnabled

        public boolean isShardAwarenessEnabled()
        Returns whether shard awareness is enabled.

        When true, the driver assumes the load balancer is configured to forward the driver's original source port to ScyllaDB (e.g. via Proxy Protocol v2), enabling shard-aware connection routing end-to-end through the load balancer. Requires advanced-shard-awareness.enabled to be true (the default).

        Returns:
        true if shard awareness is enabled.
